svg.title: LCM Research pipeline with risk annotations
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the biomedical retrieval research pipeline from data collection to evaluation, with risk callouts at key stages

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I scale my PMC paper download to 300+ papers?')
sendPrompt('What are best practices for chunking biomedical XML papers?')
sendPrompt('Why is paper-level split important for biomedical retrieval?')
sendPrompt('How do I evaluate synthetic query quality for biomedical retrieval?')
sendPrompt('What contrastive objective should I use for embedding fine-tuning?')
sendPrompt('What retrieval benchmarks should I compare against?')
sendPrompt('Is 300 papers enough for a biomedical embedding fine-tuning paper?')
g.text: 300 papers may be too small for reviewers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is this different from BioSentBERT and PubMedBERT?')
sendPrompt('How do I filter bad synthetic queries in my training set?')
g.text: Generic queries weaken the training signal

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What baseline models should I compare against beyond the general embedding?')
sendPrompt('Should I align my evaluation with BEIR or BioASQ benchmarks?')
